title: Cluster 03 DRILL: The Molecular Basis of Cancer, and Stem Cells

One primary concept each, checked for duplicated required answers as well as duplicated labels. Q1 the two routes from a proto-oncogene to an oncogene, read off real sequence and translocation data · Q2 the recessive, two-hit, dosage logic of tumour suppressor genes · Q3 why a mutation usually does not give cancer · Q4 what makes one tumour lethal, angiogenesis and metastasis · Q5 the causative factors, argued from the reverse direction · Q6 potency and the defining features of stem cells · Q7 the blood lineage, lymphoid against myeloid · Q8 the whole mutation-to-cancer pathway produced from memory · Q9 infection and lost immunity as causes · Q10 what distinguishes the stem cell types, and why each is the right clinical tool. Where an outcome is touched twice the two questions need different paragraphs of recall. Q8 is a synthesis essay by design and revisits ground covered earlier, which is why it is placed after the questions it draws on.

Why so much of this drill is figure-led. Data and figure interpretation is 33.5 per cent of the papers and 35.9 per cent of it is figure, table or micrograph led. Any drill for this Book that is mostly text-only is not modelling the exam.
